title: Uwell Crown X Replacement Coils - 4 Pack
description: The Uwell Crown X Replacement Coils are compatible with the Uwell Crown X Pod System Kit and Uwell Crown X Empty Pod Cartridge, and are precision-engineered to provide quick heating and extended durability. Crafted with a premium heating element, each coil ensures efficient and even heat distribution, enhancing the flavour and vapour production of your favourite e-liquids. The mesh build of these sub-ohm coils further intensifies the flavour and vapour, making every puff a delight. The Uwell Crown X Coils come in two resistance options: 0.3ohm for a rich and airy DTL experience, and 0.6ohm for a balanced and flavour focused RDTL vape. These coils are sold in packs of four, ensuring you have a steady supply for a consistent and satisfying vaping journey. Whether you're a cloud chaser or a flavour enthusiast, the Uwell Crown X Coils provide the flexibility and performance to excel at both. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
